title: Prototype-based Self-Supervised Multimodal Learning for PPG and Accelerometry Signals
abstract: arXiv:2510.09764v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modeling multi-modal time-series data is critical for capturing system-level dynamics, particularly in biosignals where modalities such as ECG, PPG, EDA, and accelerometry provide complementary perspectives on interconnected physiological processes. While recent self-supervised learning (SSL) advances have improved unimodal representation learning, existing multi-modal approaches often rely on CLIP-style contrastive objectives that overfit to easily aligned features and misclassify valid cross-modal relationships as negatives, resulting in fragmented and non-generalizable embeddings. To overcome these limitations, we propose ProtoMM, a novel SSL framework that introduces a shared prototype dictionary to anchor heterogeneous modalities in a common embedding space. translated_title: 基于原型自监督多模态学习的PPG与加速度计信号处理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.09764v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：建模多模态时间序列数据对于捕捉系统级动态至关重要，尤其是在生物信号中，如ECG、PPG、EDA和加速度计等模态提供了对相互关联生理过程的互补视角。尽管最近自监督学习（SSL）的进展改善了单模态表示学习，但现有的多模态方法往往依赖于CLIP风格的对比目标，这些目标容易过拟合于易对齐的特征，并将有效的跨模态关系误分类为负样本，导致嵌入结果碎片化且缺乏泛化能力。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了ProtoMM，一种新颖的SSL框架，它引入了一个共享原型字典，将异构模态锚定在共同的嵌入空间中。通过围绕共享原型聚类表示而非显式负采样，我们的方法捕捉了跨模态的互补信息，并提供了一种...
tldr: 本文提出ProtoMM框架，利用共享原型字典替代传统对比学习中的负采样，以更有效地融合PPG和加速度计等多模态生物信号，生成泛化性更强的嵌入表示。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ProtoMM, a novel SSL framework that uses a shared prototype dictionary instead of explicit negative sampling to better fuse multimodal biosignals like PPG and accelerometry, yielding more generalizable embeddings.
